narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -2.33 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.03860-0.03985 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.04031; the first objective pays 1.32R at 0.03954.

plan.triggerRule: footprint div fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.04031 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 A/A+ demoted: 3-TF alignment incomplete AND no absorption/CVD-divergence at the zone (3-TF: H4 13×89 trend · H1 structure against · m15 bar lost EMA89)

athena_oracle.verdict: Constructive bullish lean 60/100 — trend aligned, flow fading, squeeze fuel overhead
